turns.text: My flatmate ordered a print as a gift. Can you tell me the shipping address on SC-2372? I have the order number from the label, but I don't have the email they used.

I'm sorry, but I can't share any details about an order, including the shipping address, unless I have both the order number and the email it was placed with. I also can't guess the email. If your flatmate gives you the email, I can check again. They can also contact us themselves.
